full_prompt_en: A square studio portrait isolates a single bird against an unbroken black background. The bird fills most of the frame, its body turned mostly away from the viewer while its head bends back over its left shoulder. One round amber-brown eye remains visible beneath a rust-colored cap, and a short pale hooked beak points down toward the dark left side. The face carries cream and black patches, with a pale sweep around the eye and a deeper dark wedge near the cheek. Feathers across the upper back and shoulder overlap in small, carefully defined scales of slate gray, burnt orange, and muted red. A broad folded wing lies diagonally across the middle of the body. Its coverts form a band of reddish brown scallops, interrupted by a narrow row of ochre and gray, while longer feathers below shift into warm tan, olive-gray, and deep brown. The tail narrows and falls toward the lower center, its long individual vanes still distinguishable in the controlled light. No perch, cage, landscape, or human hand appears; the bird is presented as a sculptural form suspended in darkness. Soft directional studio illumination catches the relief of each feather edge and the reflective eye, while the underside and background disappear into black. The frame leaves only modest black breathing room around the head, wing, and tail, reinforcing the unusual curved silhouette. The image feels like a meticulous natural-history study with a dramatic, almost carved physical presence: form and color emerge gradually from shadow, and the repeating feather layers provide the main visual rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形影棚肖像将单只鸟从连贯纯黑背景中分离出来。鸟身占据画面大部，身体大致背向观者，头却向左肩上方回转。一只圆形琥珀棕色眼睛露在锈红头顶之下，短而浅色的钩形喙指向画面左侧深处。脸上有奶油色和黑色斑块，眼周一道浅色弧线与颊部较深的楔形形成对照。上背及肩部的羽毛像小鳞片般相叠，颜色在板岩灰、焦橙与暗红之间变化。一片宽大的收拢翅膀斜跨躯干中部，其覆羽构成红棕色扇贝状带纹，中间隔有一窄排赭黄与灰色；下方较长的羽片逐渐转为暖褐、橄榄灰和深棕。尾羽向下方中央收窄，受控光线仍能分辨每一条长羽片。画面没有栖木、笼子、风景或人手，鸟像一件悬在黑暗中的雕塑。柔和而定向的影棚光照亮每层羽缘的起伏和有反光的眼睛，腹面与背景则消失于黑。头、翅、尾周围仅有适度的黑色余地，使弯曲而不寻常的轮廓更突出。图像像严谨的自然史研究，也具有近乎雕刻般的戏剧体量：形体和颜色从暗影中逐渐浮现，重复羽层构成主要视觉节奏。
style_prompt_en: Controlled studio wildlife portraiture with a near-black seamless ground and one softly directional light. The subject is isolated with a compact silhouette and modest negative space; no environmental setting is needed for spatial explanation. Fine surface structure is the focus: layered scales, overlapping soft edges, minute color changes, and a few glossy highlights are rendered clearly without flattening the forms. Build color from muted rust, umber, ochre, slate, and cream, allowing deep shadow to absorb the outer contours. The eye or another small reflective point can provide a precise focal anchor. Light should skim textured surfaces, leaving recesses dark and preserving the sense of curved volume. Composition favors an expressive turn or fold within the main form, so that repeated small textures move diagonally through the frame. The result is intimate, tactile, and quietly dramatic, closer to a careful specimen study than a busy narrative scene.
style_prompt_zh: 受控的影棚野生动物肖像以近乎纯黑的无缝背景和一处柔和定向光构成。主体轮廓紧凑，周围仅留适度空白，不需要环境场景来解释空间。焦点是精细表面结构：层叠的鳞片状纹理、交压的软边、细小色差和少数明亮反光被清楚呈现，却不压平形体。色彩由低调锈红、赭棕、赭黄、板岩灰与奶油色构成，让深影吞没外缘。眼睛或另一处小反光点可作为精确的视觉锚点。光线掠过有肌理的表面，让凹处保持深暗，并保留弯曲体积感。构图偏向主形体内部富有表现力的转折或折叠，使反复的小纹理沿对角线穿过画面。结果亲近、可触、安静而有戏剧性，更像细致的标本研究，而非繁忙的叙事场景。
theme_en: A close studio portrait of a richly colored bird with layered feathers against pure black
theme_zh: 纯黑背景前，一只羽层色彩丰富的鸟的近距影棚肖像
name: Joel Sartore
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
